input.classification: Digital slide PDF with native text; not a confirmed physical paper scan

headingAgreement.method: Native heading vs raw OCR; whitespace/NFKC comparison, not character accuracy

keyword.method: production chunker + production scoped BM25 SQL on local SQLite FTS5; heading queries from native text, not independent natural-language questions

limitations: No CER/WER or whole-document mathematical accuracy
No Cloudflare upload, source hash embedding idempotency or deletion evaluation
One source only; scoped lookup is not a multi-user or cross-folder isolation test
Short slides did not exercise multi-chunk overlap
No physical iPad memory or execution measurements
